7s warm, intimate home living-room scene based on the source image. Medium shot, eye-level, stable composition. A graceful East Asian mother sits on a brown sofa in a beige knit outfit, pearl earrings, delicate necklace, hair neatly pinned up. Another person's hands are gently placing a prayer bracelet onto the mother's right wrist. Keep the original identity, face, hairstyle, outfit, posture, sofa, curtains, shelf decor, warm indoor color palette, bracelet, beads, bead order, pendant, helper hands and wrist relationship consistent with the source image.

Visual emotion only: the mother has a touched, gentle, natural expression with softer eyes, one natural blink, a small closed-mouth smile that becomes slightly warmer, and calm breathing. She is not talking.

Motion rules: the body, shoulders, torso, seated posture, hands, wrist, bracelet, beads, pendant, helper hands, sleeves and lower arms should remain frozen and unchanged. The head position should stay nearly in the same place. No bowing, no nodding, no leaning forward, no chin drop, no big head movement, no body movement. Only tiny facial expression change and tiny eye movement are allowed.

Mouth rules: no lip sync, no speaking mouth, no mouth movement. The mother's mouth stays closed throughout.

Commercial, clean, elegant, emotionally warm, realistic, stable composition.
